youtube.title: Why Planes Make You Raise the Window Shade ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Cabin crews ask passengers to open window shades and dim the lights during takeoff and landing. Most aviation accidents happen near the ground, and an evacuation could start within seconds. Eyes already adjusted to the outside light can spot fire or debris immediately, and rescuers can see into the cabin.
